rows.col_1: GET https://developer.api.autodesk.com/bim360/docs/v1/projects/:projectId/naming-standards/:id
user context optional
data:read
JSON
Must be Bearer <token>, where <token> is obtained via either a two-legged or three-legged OAuth flow.

The region to which your request should be routed. If not set, the request is routed automatically but may incur a small latency increase.
Possible values: US, EMEA.

The ID of the project.
This corresponds to project ID in the Data Management API. To convert a project ID in the Data Management API into a project ID in the BIM 360 API you need to remove the “b." prefix. For example, a project ID of b.a4be0c34a-4ab7 translates to a project ID of a4be0c34a-4ab7.
To learn how to find the project ID, see the Retrieve BIM 360 Account and Project ID tutorial.

The ID of the file naming standard.
The file naming standard is applied to the project files folder or its subfolders. To find the ID:

For the project files folder, call GET hubs/:hub_id/projects/:project_id/topFolders.
For subfolders, call GET projects/:project_id/folders/:folder_id/contents.
For a specific folder, call GET projects/:project_id/folders/:folder_id.

The ID is under data.attributes.extension.data.namingStandardIds.
Successfully retrieved the file naming standard.
The parameters of the requested operation are invalid.
The user or service represented by the bearer token does not have permission to perform this operation.
The file naming standard does not exist.
An unknown error occurred on the server.
The ID of file naming standard.
The name of the file naming standard.
The file naming standard format.

A specified character, separating between multiple fields of a file name.
Possible values:

-: Hyphen.
_: Underscore.
.: Point.

Note that you cannot use the delimiter within a field name.

A list of objects defining a file’s field names.
Note that the order of the objects that the endpoint returns in the response corresponds to the order of the fields that you set for the naming standard in the UI.

The name of the field.
Max length: 32

The field type.
Possible values:

ALPHANUMERIC: Accepts all characters.
NONNUMERIC_TEXT: Accepts all characters, excluding 0-9.
NUMERIC: Accepts 0-9, comma ',', plus '+', minus '-', percent '%', period '.', underscore '_'.
ARRAY: A drop-down list.

Note that the minLength and maxLength properties are not included in the response for the ARRAY type.
The ID of the field.

true: this field is required in the file naming convention.
false: this field is not required in the file naming convention.

The minimum length of the field name.
Min number of characters: 1

The maximum length of the field name.
Max number of characters: 10

The default value of the field.
For example, PROJ.

A drop-down list of possible values for the field.
Only relevant for a field of type ARRAY (drop-down list).
A drop-down list value.
A description of the drop-down list value.

A description of the field.
Max length: 255
A list of objects defining a file’s related attributes. These attributes do not appear in the file name.
The ID of the related attribute.

The name of the related attribute.
Max length: 32

The related attribute type.
Possible values:

ALPHANUMERIC: Accepts all characters.
NONNUMERIC_TEXT: Accepts all characters, excluding 0-9.
NUMERIC: Includes 0-9, comma ',', plus '+', minus '-', percent '%', period '.', underscore '_'.
ARRAY: A drop-down list.
CLASSIFICATION: Only relevant for a classification attribute.

Note that the minLength and maxLength properties are not included in the response for the ARRAY type.

true: this related attribute is required.
false: this related attribute is not required.

The minimum length of the related attribute.
Min number of characters: 1

The maximum length of the related attribute.
Max number of characters: 10
The default value of the related attribute.

A drop-down list of possible values for the related attribute.
Only relevant for a related attribute of type ARRAY (drop-down list).
A drop-down list value.
A description of the drop-down list value.

A description of the related attribute.
Max length: 255
